events.title: Idle Camp Tale at Steam Next Fest — Try the Free Demo!
events.summary: Hi everyone! Steam Next Fest is here, and the free demo of Idle Camp Tale is available to play. The demo includes the complete first chapter. Recruit heroes, choose their skills and equipment, and take on stages to find loot and strengthen your party through forging. Your heroes fight automatically while the game is running, so you can return to sort your gear, adjust your lineup, and take on the next challenge. events.title: Dev Log #2: Climb the 100-Floor Babel Tower
events.summary: Hi everyone, The free demo covers Chapter 1. Today I want to talk about something that unlocks after you finish all five main chapters in the full game: the Babel Tower. The tower has 100 floors, and every floor is a boss fight. On regular floors, you'll face 3–4 randomly selected bosses from the same chapter. Every tenth floor is a milestone battle against one giant boss. As you climb, enemies get stronger, and the gear and crafting materials you earn get better too. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46178721
